function.name: single_event_count
function.description: Given a variable name corresponding to an event and specifying information, return the event count. If plot is True, return a plot of the event count over time. Return format is a dictionary with keys 'count' and 'plot', where the value for 'plot' is a placeholder for a plotly figure. Return format is a dictionary with keys 'count' and 'plot', where the value for 'plot' is a placeholder string for a plotly figure.

p.description: people associated with the event (default: null)

dr.description: date range of the event (default: null)

tr.description: time range of the event (default: null)

d.description: days associated with the event (default: null)

plot.description: Whether to return a plot. (default: true)
